name: Notte
summary: Notte's API: scrape pages to markdown or structured JSON, and search the web.

api_key.description: A Notte API key (console.notte.cc/apikeys). Sent as Authorization: Bearer.

notes: Browser work runs in a session: sessions.start, then page.goto, page.act and page.scrape with its session_id, then sessions.stop. A session also closes after idle_timeout_minutes (default 3) or max_duration_minutes (default 15). The hosted agent APIs are deprecated.
POST /sessions/start is rate limited per key by minute, hour and day; too many active sessions also returns 429 (NotteApiMaxActiveResourcesError).
Other page actions, profiles, vaults, personas, functions, the Anything API and the Data APIs (monitors, maps, news, people) are not in this entry.

endpoints.name: Scrape a page
endpoints.summary: A page as markdown with links, or structured data shaped by instructions or a JSON Schema, from a one-off browser session.

only_main_content.description: Drop navbars, footers and the like. Default false.

selector.description: Playwright selector to scope the scrape to.

instructions.description: What to extract, e.g. 'Extract only the title, date and content of the articles.'

response_format.description: A JSON Schema for structured output.

model.description: Model for structured extraction, as an OpenRouter id (e.g. google/gemini-3.5-flash).

solve_captchas.description: Try to solve captchas. Default true.

proxies.description: Use Notte's default proxies (true, the default) or not.

notes: A read over POST. It opens and closes a browser session for you.

endpoints.name: Search the web
endpoints.summary: Search results, a sourced answer, or structured output for a query.

depth.description: How thorough the search is. Default standard.

endpoints.name: Get usage
endpoints.summary: Account usage for a monthly period.

period.description: The month, e.g. 'May 2025'; the current one by default.
